Four parts. 68-3a DECOMPOSITION: visited_C/visited_B factors as (ev_C/ev_B) x (vpe_C/vpe_B), where vpe = visited/ev is the mean page-list length the loop walks. Both factors are REPORTED SEPARATELY and both are predicted above 1, with the list-length factor dominating; the existing A-to-C numbers are ev 7.9x and vpe 75x, product 592x. This separates "the loop runs more often" -- pages stay armed, so more stores reach the invalidator, reach_share 0.33 -> 0.80 -- from "each run walks further", which are two different mechanisms with two different remedies, and only the first is visible in `stores`. Denominators: ev_B is at least 1 while the title runs and vpe_B is at least 1 by definition, since an event that found a block visited at least one. 68-3b PLATEAU, AND THIS IS THE PART THAT CAN STOP THE FOLD. On every arm-C run, the median of vpe over the LAST THIRD of post-boot windows is at most 1.25x its median over the MIDDLE THIRD. The three existing arm-C runs give 0.976x, so 1.25 is a bound with room and not a curve fit. If vpe GROWS instead, the spared-block population is bounded only by translation-buffer flush -- which #68 does not control -- and a 90 s soak then says nothing about an hours-long play session, so the fold stops. A monotone leak is a live possibility that neither commit forces either way, which is what makes this a falsifier rather than a description. 68-3c CAPACITY CEILING, also fold-stopping. On every arm-C run the median vpe stays below B_page = 4096 / ((bytes/ins) x blk), every term read from that run's own inval line: the number of non-overlapping blocks that fit in a 4 KiB guest page at that run's own measured mean block size. The existing runs give B_page 201-225 against vpe 75-81, about 2.7x of headroom. Above B_page the page list holds more entries than the page has distinct block starts, so the surplus cannot be the page's live code and must be superseded translations accumulating -- the leak shape reached from the other side. The threshold is the geometry of a 4 KiB page computed per run, not a number chosen after seeing 75. 68-3d WHAT THE PRICE CANNOT BE READ IN. If arm C's gfps max is below arm B's on every run pairing, the added visit work reached frame scale even in a soak, and that stops the fold. If it is not, NOTHING IS ESTABLISHED: a dispatcher soak injects no input, and this project has already measured that Crimson Skies' guest CPU thread is not its critical path -- #44 saw p90 fall by 0 and max by 3 while the guest was blocked 30.7% of wall clock at a hold 74% larger than Galleon's.
